articles.title: RandBall: Could the Twins’ next matchup with the Yankees finally come on a more level playing field?
articles.description: The Twins are 49-130 against New York over the past 25 seasons, a run of misery shaped partly by a massive payroll gap. MLB’s next labor deal could change that equation.

articles.title: Walker Jenkins busts out of slump to rally Twins, but it isn’t enough vs. Angels
articles.description: The struggling 21-year-old rookie tied the game in Anaheim with a two-run homer in the ninth, and the Twins took a lead in the 10th before losing 5-4.

articles.title: Inside the Twins’ second-half collapse: How their playoff hopes fell apart after the trade deadline
articles.description: The Twins entered August with a winning record and a share of the final AL wild-card spot. Six weeks and 25 losses later, injuries, pitching struggles and costly mistakes have pushed them out of ...

articles.title: Twins routed by Yankees again; rookie Kaelen Culpepper leaves because of injury
articles.description: Cody Bellinger and Spencer Jones homered as the Yankees, one night after clinching a playoff spot, rolled past the Twins. Bailey Ober took the loss.

articles.title: Emmanuel Rodriguez homers in first big league at-bat during Twins win: ‘What a day today’
articles.description: The 23-year-old outfielder joined Walker Jenkins and Kaelen Culpepper among Twins prospects getting their first major league opportunities down the stretch.

articles.title: Minnesota’s pro teams are worth a combined $17 billion. Why are some soaring in value?
articles.description: From the Lynx’s rapid rise to the Twins’ slower growth, media rights and league economics are driving dramatically different franchise values across Minnesota sports.

articles.title: Byron Buxton injury update: MN Twins star to have season-ending surgery
articles.description: Buxton had hoped to return for the Twins’ playoff push, but will undergo season-ending surgery on his right hip. He is expected to be ready for the start of the 2027 season.

articles.title: Minnesota Twins’ Matt Wallner expects to be off roster after season
articles.description: The Forest Lake native has put up big numbers in the minors, but sees no path back with the Twins. He remains confident he can succeed in the majors — somewhere else.

articles.title: Reusse: Twins fans have waited years for a leadoff hitter like Luke Keaschall. He’s worth embracing.
articles.description: Keaschall has the speed, power and patience the Twins have long coveted atop their lineup. And the 24-year-old former wrestler brings some old-school toughness, too.

articles.title: The Twins’ infield defense has been a weak spot for years. Brooks Lee changed that with one move.
articles.description: The former first-round pick ranks among MLB’s top defenders at his new position, a development that has exceeded even the Twins’ expectations.

articles.title: Twins fall to Yankees in series opener as New York clinches AL playoff berth at Target Field
articles.description: New York secured at least a wild-card spot Monday with an 8-3 victory as the Twins continued evaluating top prospects over the final two weeks of the season.

articles.title: Twins still have a heartbeat, edge Tigers behind Kody Clemens’ home run
articles.description: Dean Kremer and four relievers combined to stymie Detroit, but the Twins remain 4½ games behind in the AL wild card race.
